Write, dear, when you feel like it.
Lovingly,
Emily.

Dear Lady Mayo—
Your lovely flowers have just come. … I think nothing gives me such joy and delight as spring flowers, and after this long, long winter how delightful it is to have them back again. … I am just now going into Surrey to paint primroses.
I feel I must send you a flower also. I wish it could be as lovely as yours!
With kind regards and again thanks, yours very sincerely,
Kate Greenaway.

text: The crowd is thick. To place one’s chair in some tolerable position on the deck requires a degree of physical power which I lack. I have taken my shelter in a corner of the music saloon where space itself has not become impenetrable. Long before the sunrise, when it is dark, I sit on the deck and wish that I could have the great solitude of the sea and the sky safely packed in my trunk with a label on it, “Required on Deck”.

M. Lamb.

My dear Friend,
I think no event has happened in the house of greater consequence … than that a little mouse makes its appearance sometimes under the dining-room grate, and disappears we know not how, for we can find no hole for its escape! This John desired I would communicate to you. He thinks it is a fairy in the shape of a mouse … You are therefore called upon to reflect on this prodigy, and favour us with your conjectures.
Believe me, ever your affectionate friend,
D. Wordsworth.

Meu querido Bernardo e querido Vicente
Joias
Depois da nossa memoravel separação em V.ª N.ª de Famalicão (digo memoravel porque a nossa viagem é um dos mais interessantes episodios da historia contemporanea) Ficalho e eu preparamo-nos, segundo as boas tradicções — para dizer mal de vós. Tenho saudades de Pindella.
Abraço apertado a vós ambos, joias, do
Vosso do C.

My dearest friends,
I have her majesty’s commands to inquire—whether you have any of a certain breed of poultry?
N.B. What breed I do not remember.
And to say she has just received a small group of the same herself.
N.B. The quantity I have forgotten.
And to add, she is assured they are something very rare and scarce, and extraordinary and curious.
N.B. By whom she was assured I have not heard.
So now—pray write a very fair answer fairly, in fair hand, and to her fair purpose.

Affectionately yours,
H. Stowe.

Caro Ricordi (Tito),
Piove, piove e piove!! Addio campagna, addio passeggiate, addio bel sole che non vedremo più che pallido ed ammalato; addio bel cielo azzurro, addio spazio infinito, addio desiderj e speranze di venire a Como! Quattro pareti sostituiranno l’infinito: il fuoco invece del sole; i libri e la musica rimpiazzeranno l’aria ed il cielo; la noja invece del piacere!
Parto per Torino, ove mi fermerò per otto o dieci giorni. Scrivimi e spedisci colà.

Aux Rochers, 22e juillet 1671.
Savez-vous ce que c’est que faner ? Il faut que je vous l’explique : faner est la plus jolie chose du monde, c’est retourner du foin en batifolant dans une prairie ; dès qu’on en sait tant, on sait faner. Tous mes gens y allèrent gaiement ; le seul Picard me vint dire qu’il n’iroit pas, … que ce n’étoit pas son métier, et qu’il aimoit mieux s’en aller à Paris.
Voilà l’histoire en peu de mots.

Meine geliebte Sonitschka,

Ma Lolo chérie,
Je ferai partir demain une caisse à ton adresse. Tu y trouveras :

Deux ombrelles roses pour vous deux.
Une ombrelle parapluie pour toi.

Je vous bige à mort ; je m’ennuie bien sans vous, mais je ne resterai pas longtemps.
Aimez toujours votre boune mè, qui vous chérit.

My dear Fanny,

Ever your affectionate Brother
John.

Eleven o’clock.
Dear Prue,
I desire you to get the coach and yourself ready as soon as you can conveniently, and call for me here, from whence we will go and spend some time together in the fresh air in free conference. Let my best periwig be put in the coach-box, and my new shoes, for it is a great comfort to be well dressed in agreeable company.
You are vital life to your obliged, affectionate husband, and humble servant.

Anoche te escribí y rompí la carta, esta noche te escribo también: pero salga como quiera no la romperé. Resígnate.
